sentences.ar: ג'וחא שתל עץ זית כשהיה זקן.
sentences.en: Juha planted an olive tree when he was old.

sentences.ar: השכן צחק ואמר: לא תאכל ממנו.
sentences.en: The neighbour laughed and said: you will not eat from it.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אכלתי מעצים שלא שתלתי.
sentences.en: He said: I ate from trees I did not plant.
And someone else will eat from this one.
